system.description: After an ally declares a Blaze of Glory, you may attempt to reignite their soul from the brink by spending 3 Hope and making a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, the fire within them is kindled; they survive, unconscious or broken, but alive. You must then pass an Instinct (25) or immediately lose access to the Fire Within. You must embark on a journey that reignites your purpose to gain it again.
